200.description: A paginated list of products matching the search, filter, and sort criteria.

example.name: Coastal Breeze Men's Blue Zipper Hoodie
example.shortDescription: Stay warm and stylish with the Coastal Breeze Men's Blue Zipper Hoodie.

operation.summary: List products with search, filter, sort, and pagination
operation.description: Mirrors the GraphQL products query. Any query param outside the reserved set (query, sort, order, page, per_page, locale, channel, filter, suggest) is treated as a filterable attribute — so new attributes like material, pattern, etc. work automatically without schema changes.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search term (matches SKU or product name).

parameters.name: suggest
parameters.description: Elasticsearch only: when the store searches with Elasticsearch, the query is swapped for its "did you mean" suggestion (see `GET /api/shop/search-redirect`). Send `0` to search the exact query instead.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Compound sort token. One of: name-asc, name-desc, price-asc, price-desc, created_at-desc (newest first), created_at-asc (oldest first), updated_at-desc, updated_at-asc, id-asc, id-desc. May also be used with a separate `order` param (e.g. sort=name&order=desc).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction when `sort` is a bare key (e.g. sort=name&order=desc). Ignored if `sort` already has a -asc/-desc suffix.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Default matches the GraphQL `first` default.

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: Compound price range — from,to (e.g. 10,200). Alternative to price_from + price_to.

parameters.name: new
parameters.description: Only return products flagged as new.

parameters.name: featured
parameters.description: Only return products flagged as featured.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Attribute filters as a dynamic key/value map. In Swagger UI, click "Add string item" to add a row, enter the attribute code as the key (e.g. brand, color, size, material, any filterable attribute) and the option ID as the value. Multi-select: comma-separate option IDs (e.g. 1,2,3). Generates URLs like ?filter[brand]=38&filter[color]=3. A raw JSON filter string is also accepted for GraphQL parity, e.g. {"color":{"match":"3","match_type":"PARTIAL"}}.

parameters.name: X-STOREFRONT-KEY
parameters.description: Storefront API Key for authentication. Required for all shop/storefront API requests.

parameters.name: X-Locale
parameters.description: Locale code for localized data (e.g. "en", "fr", "ar"). Defaults to channel's default locale.

parameters.name: X-Channel
parameters.description: Channel code (e.g. "default"). Defaults to the current channel.

parameters.name: X-Currency
parameters.description: Currency code (e.g. "USD", "EUR", "INR"). Defaults to channel's base currency.
